description: Bus open data is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Data Mill North. The Bus Open Data Service provides high quality information about bus services in England. This helps passengers and the bus industry. The Bus Services Act 2017 requires all public bus operators in England to provide this information from 2020. It will eventually include route and timetable, fares and real time data. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Data Mill North. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
